uslaw-usc-t2-s285d:
Section 285d of Title 2 of the United States Code covers staff and delegation in the Office of Law Revision Counsel. Title 2 covers Congress, and this section sits in the chapter on that office. The office keeps the United States Code in order. The hosted text is the version current in twenty twenty six.

With the approval of the Speaker, or under policies the Speaker has approved, the Counsel appoints staff, the text states. Those employees must be such as are needed for prompt and sound performance of the office's functions. A Deputy Law Revision Counsel is also provided for in the section. Delegation of functions within the office is covered, so work can flow when the Counsel is away.
